{{Quote|Let me tell you, "grand" does not begin to describe the scene here. It is absolutely glorious, and the breathtaking setting for this evening's podrace.|[[Dax Gazaway]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>}}
The '''Grand Reefs''' were large coral banks located on the aquatic planet of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], located near the city of [[Orotoru G'am]]. Above the water, it featured large boulders and was decorated with tall statues of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. They were also the site of a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course.

This was the habitat of Dac's [[cubicle worm]].

==History==
As of [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] was the track favorite. The Grand Reefs were the last of Dac's three podraces, and the second of the [[Hutt Championships]].
